```{r}
#| label: setup
library(tidyverse)
library(wooldridge)
library(margins)
library(flextable)
```

## Category variables

### Marginal effects in interaction model

```{r}
wage2 <- get(data(wage2))
```

```{r}
reg <- lm(wage ~ educ + educ*black, data = wage2)
```

The function `margins::margins()` gives SE for both cases of `educ`effect, i.e. the effect education has on wage for black people and the effect it has for white people. We see that education has a significant positive effect on wage for white people while the effect is insignificant for black people.

```{r}
margins(
  reg, 
  at = list(black = 0:1)
  ) |> 
  summary()  |>  
  filter(factor == "educ") |> 
  as_flextable(
    show_coltype = FALSE
  ) |> 
  colformat_double(digits = 3) |> 
  line_spacing(space = 0.3, part = "all") |> 
  delete_part(part = "footer")
```

```{r}
# The data needed
margs <- summary(
  margins(reg, 
          at = list(black = 0:1, 
                    south = 0:1)
          )
  ) %>% 
  filter(factor == "educ") %>% 
  mutate(
    Term = fct(
      case_when(
        black == 1 ~ "Black Workers",
        black == 0 ~ "Non-black Workers"
        )
      ),
    Race = fct(
      case_when(
        black == 1 ~ "Black", 
        black == 0 ~ "Non-black"
        )
      )
  )
```

```{r}
#| paged.print: false
margs
```

```{r}
margs %>% 
  ggplot() + 
  geom_hline(
    yintercept = 0, 
    linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_pointrange(
    mapping = aes(
      x = Term, 
      y = AME, 
      ymin = lower, 
      ymax = upper, 
      colour = Race), 
    size = 1) +
  coord_flip() + 
  xlab("") + 
  ylab("Marginal Effect of Education on Wages") +
  scale_color_manual(
    NULL, 
    values = c("red", "darkslategrey"), 
    labels = c("Non-black", "Black")
    ) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom"
  )
```
## Schoolspending

```{r}
# MI school funding and test scores data
# exppp: expenditures per pupil: expend/enroll
meap01 <- wooldridge::meap01
meap01 <- meap01  %>% 
  mutate(
    spend = exppp/1000
    )
```

```{r}
# read ~ spend
lm_r_s <- lm(
  formula = 'read4 ~ spend', 
  data = meap01
  )

lm_r_s_l <- lm(
  formula = 'read4 ~ spend + lunch', 
  data = meap01
  )

lm_r_s_l_sl <- lm(
  formula = 'read4 ~ spend + spend * lunch', 
  data = meap01
  )
```

```{r}
# 'read4 ~ spend'
lm_r_s |> 
  as_flextable() |> 
  line_spacing(
    space = 0.3, part = "all"
    ) |> 
  fontsize(size = 9, part = "all")
```

```{r}
# 'read4 ~ spend + lunch'
lm_r_s_l |> 
  as_flextable() |> 
  line_spacing(
    space = 0.3, part = "all"
    ) |> 
  fontsize(size = 9, part = "all")
```

```{r}
# 'read4 ~ spend + spend * lunch'
lm_r_s_l_sl |> 
  as_flextable() |> 
  line_spacing(
    space = 0.3, part = "all"
    ) |> 
  fontsize(size = 9, part = "all")
```
